maria_content: Quick sync — Aurum Edge customer story: final interview scheduled Fri 10am PT. Need quote approvals + legal sign-off by EOD Thu.
elaine_marketing: Got it. Can we pare to a 2-sentence hero quote for the launch post? Also need logo (SVG) and 1–2 screenshots.
tom_prod: I can pull the perf numbers for the benchmark. We measured ~2x latency improvement vs their old infra. ETA Wed.
lex_legal: Please share the draft quote and any customer PII. I'll check the release + NDA for redlines. If nothing risky I can sign off by Thu EOD.
maria_content: Draft quote below — drop comments: "Redwood cut our inference costs in half while improving latency and reliability. The team deployed in under two weeks and the results shipped immediately."
raj_growth: Heads-up: Sales wants inbound leads from the case routed to the enterprise SDR queue. @elaine can we add a campaign tag so Pardot/Salesforce picks it up?
elaine_marketing: :thumbsup: I'll add utm_campaign=aurum-edge-spotlight and tag in Pardot. Also planning a short webinar in two weeks — they'd present a customer panel.
tom_prod: Aurum is OK with a high-level talk only. They'll need a slide template and an outline. Maria, can you prep a 6-slide deck?
maria_content: On it — will draft slides + hero quote by Wed AM and drop in the project board for review.
lex_legal: Also need the signed release form from the customer. @maria can you upload the release so I can cross-check terms (esp. logos and quote usage)?
publish-bot: Reminder: marketing-assets bucket policy blocks uploads over 100MB. Use shared link or compress assets.
maria_content: Uploaded release (link) and low-res screenshots to the board. Full assets coming via SFTP tonight. Ping me if access issues.
elaine_marketing: :rocket: Nice. Can we get a one-line headline by Thu noon so we can lock social scheduling?
raj_growth: I'll wire up the SDR routing once the UTM is live and update the inbound playbook.
maria_content: Closing loop — timeline: Wed AM assets + quote, Thu EOD legal sign-off, Fri 10am recording. I'll update the Trello card and ping reviewers.
